note: The new dns option points Kuma at 127.0.0.53, which inside the container is its own loopback without a resolver, so every check fails with EAI_AGAIN while the sites answer normally; the All monitors red section matches the symptom but says no change causes it and its fix (force-recreate) keeps the dns option, so the expected runbook is none.

cause.title: fix: resolve monitored hosts like the server does
cause.author: Philipp Klinger
cause.patch:
diff --git a/compose.yaml b/compose.yaml
@@ -9,6 +9,8 @@ services:
     environment:
       # Skips the database setup page on the first start; SQLite lives in the volume below
       UPTIME_KUMA_DB_TYPE: sqlite
+    # Same resolver as the host (systemd-resolved), so the checks get the DNS answers visitors get
+    dns: [127.0.0.53]
     volumes:
       # SQLite database: monitors, status pages, notifications and the uptime history
       - kuma_data:/app/data
